project_reference.core_research_question: Reactor-CEvNS, cosmic-muon, and environmental-gamma Compton spectra in reconstructed energy for a 4"×4"×2mm single-sided Ge wafer read out by QPDs (Ta→Al and Al→Hf designs).
project_reference.current_focus: Phase 1 complete ✓ — next: Phase 2 (Reactor Flux Model) and Phase 4 (Muon & Compton) can start

scope.question: What are the reactor-CEvNS signal and the full in-band particle-background budget, in reconstructed energy down to 100 meV, for a 4 inch x 4 inch x 2 mm (~110 g) single-sided Ge wafer read out by QPDs (Ta->Al and Al->Hf trapping designs) deployed at the NUCLEUS Chooz Very-Near-Site behind the NUCLEUS shielding - and what signal-to-background does that give?
in_scope: Reactor CEvNS spectrum in reconstructed energy at the Chooz Very-Near-Site: two Chooz-B cores, 4.25 GWth each, at 72 m and 102 m, integral flux 2.1e12 nubar/cm2/s, 80% operating duty

Residual particle backgrounds behind the NUCLEUS shielding (5 cm plastic-scintillator muon veto + 5 cm low-activity Pb + 20 cm 5%-borated HDPE external; internal Pb/PE + ~4pi 4 cm B4C + cold muon veto; HPGe cryogenic outer veto at 1 keVee; Si inner veto), with their measured normalizations and attenuations adopted and the target response re-folded for germanium
All spectra extended down to 100 meV, two decades below the v1.0 10.14 eV grid floor, below the per-sensor saturation onsets (~1.27 eV Ta->Al, ~0.77 eV Al->Hf)
Impulse-approximation quantum broadening of the nuclear recoil (sigma_E = sqrt(E_R * omega_bar)) applied before the response chain
A trigger-probability curve as the reported observable below ~1 eV deposit: sigmoid with its 50% point at 0.5 eV, multiplying all other efficiencies including eps ~= 0.5
Ge-only thermal-capture channels that CaWO4/Al2O3 are structurally blind to: prompt (n,gamma) cascade recoils and the 71Ge EC M-shell line at ~159 eV
Cosmic-ray muon and environmental-gamma Compton channels re-driven at the VNS overburden (2.92 m.w.e., attenuation 1.41) and the measured VNS gamma ambience (5.03 cm-2 s-1)
Low-energy excess carried as an explicitly parameterized overlay band, never folded into a headline number, with the LEE amplitude at which S/B = 1 reported as the falsifiable deliverable
Detector geometry: 4 inch x 4 inch x 2 mm Ge wafer (~110 g), single instrumented face, ~10300 QPD sensors at 1/mm2
Both trapping designs: Ta absorber to Al trap/junction and Al absorber to Hf trap/junction
out_of_scope: Full Geant4 transport of the NUCLEUS geometry (their p.21 reports tens, even hundreds, millions of hours of computing time and states variance reduction will be required) - explicit user decision
Scaling the NUCLEUS CaWO4/Al2O3 residual backgrounds to germanium by a mass argument - discards the target dependence their own paper emphasizes; explicit user decision

Coherent-crystal S(q,omega) modelling backbone - the crystal-coherent regime lies below ~21 meV, under the 100 meV floor; NCrystal/DarkELF retained only as a bounded justification and for the sub-5 eV neutron kernel
OpenMC for any transport step - unbuildable on osx-arm64; any transport fallback must be hand-rolled (SIMU-05, follow-up)
Extending the reactor antineutrino flux table below 100 keV - the truncation bound is <= 0.81% at 100 meV and exactly zero above 0.29 eV; reporting the bound is the deliverable
Splicing TENDL-2023 n-Ge elastic above the 20 MeV ENDF ceiling (CALC-24, deferred to follow-up)
G4CMP phonon-transport detector response (deferred project-wide since v1.0)
Imperfect quasiparticle-tunneling identification and readout-noise modeling
Detector geometry / sensor-layout optimization - note VALD-09 may show the fixed geometry is incompatible with the adopted veto envelope, which is a stop-condition rather than an optimization trigger
unresolved_questions: GATING STOP-CONDITION: does a 4 inch x 4 inch x 2 mm ~110 g Ge wafer fit the NUCLEUS COV/IV veto envelope, dimensioned for 6.8 g CaWO4 and 4.5 g Al2O3 3x3 arrays (103 cm2 vs ~9 cm2, and monolithic so no multiplicity handle)? If not, STOP and re-scope with the user - nothing transfers.
Are the NUCLEUS Figs. 8-11 deposit spectra pre- or post-veto? Determines whether the inverted quantity is a fluence or a veto-survival-weighted fluence.

What value of omega_bar and which Debye-Waller convention (2W = q^2<u_x^2> vs q^2<u^2>/3)? The <u^2>-derived 12-21 meV and the 37 meV optical phonon differ by 2-3x, and both 2W and sigma_E scale linearly with it.
Can the in-shield thermal neutron flux phi_th be obtained? NUCLEUS does not publish it and it gates the Ge-only capture channel; a quantified gap is acceptable, zero is not.
What LEE amplitude and spectral shape should be carried? Design-dependent for a QPD (Al-film dislocation relaxation scaling with film area, ~10300 films), so neither inheritable nor shieldable.
Does E_rec ~= 0.5*E_dep survive at 100 meV, where the down-conversion cascade truncates near optical-phonon energies and the deposit is only ~3 phonon quanta? No literature addresses this.

known_good_baselines: NUCLEUS Collab., Eur. Phys. J. C 86, 29 (2026), arXiv:2509.03559, Table 5 at 100% duty: CaWO4 residual 144 mcpd (235 counts/kg/day/keV) and CEvNS 218.2 mcpd (356.5); Al2O3 52 mcpd (128) and 8.4 mcpd (20.7), 10-100 eV RoI. ANCHOR ON THE TABLE, NOT the Sect. 2 prose 280 (that is the 80%-duty value).
NUCLEUS Collab., Eur. Phys. J. C 79, 1018 (2019), arXiv:1905.10258, Fig. 1 Ge CEvNS curve - reproduced to 5% by the VALD-02 anchor (tests/test_cevns_nucleus.py).
Our own CaWO4 closure fold: 407.7 counts/kg/day/keV, ratio 1.14 to their Table 5 - the SIGNAL-side target-swap closure test has already passed at 14%.

CONUS+ Collab., Nature 643, 1229 (2025), arXiv:2501.05206: the only measured Ge-at-a-reactor S/B, ~0.03 in 0.4-1 keVee at 7.4 m.w.e. (395 +/- 106 events in 327 kg.d, 3.7 sigma). Hard gate on any v2.0 S/B claim.
J. Billard et al., J. Phys. G 44, 105101 (2017), arXiv:1612.09035, Table 1 (0.76/0.51/0.26 counts/kg/day above 50/100/200 eV_nr) - reproduced to 2.4% in v1.0.

Whether NUCLEUS Figs. 8-11 are pre- or post-veto
omega_bar and the Debye-Waller convention for germanium

formulations: Freedman CEvNS differential cross section with Helm form factor on natural Ge folded with a 4-isotope reactor antineutrino spectrum
Klein-Nishina Compton scattering of a representative environmental gamma spectrum, thin-target single-scatter dominated, on Ge
Analytic and Monte-Carlo response chain from deposited energy to bandwidth-limited reconstructed energy using the QPD paper pulse model and the qpd-repo EMG template

claims.statement: The reactor CEvNS spectrum in reconstructed energy is computed for both trapping designs at the NUCLEUS Chooz Very-Near-Site normalization (2.1e12 nubar/cm2/s, 80% duty) down to 100 meV, with impulse-approximation broadening and the 0.5 eV trigger curve applied, and is anchored to NUCLEUS Table 5 at 100% duty

The muon spectrum in reconstructed energy is computed for both designs at the VNS overburden (2.92 m.w.e., attenuation 1.41) with chord-length geometry and the bandwidth-saturation regime made explicit

The Compton electron-recoil spectrum is computed in reconstructed energy from the MEASURED VNS gamma ambience (5.03 cm-2 s-1; 40K 59.6, 232Th 3.28, 238U 5.65 Bq/kg), replacing the v1.0 Heusser factor-2 band
The reconstructed-versus-deposited energy response, including saturation from the 25 kHz maximum resolvable tunneling rate, is derived for both trapping designs

The residual particle-background spectrum for a Ge wafer behind the NUCLEUS shielding is computed by adopting their measured environment and attenuations and re-folding the target response through germanium cross sections and kinematics, never by mass-scaling their CaWO4/Al2O3 residuals

The particle signal-to-background ratio for the Ge wafer at the VNS is assembled in the 10-100 eV region of interest with the trigger curve applied, reported alongside a zero-inherited-veto-credit baseline and an explicit LEE overlay band, and is gated on reproducing CONUS+ as a limiting case

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-cevns
acceptance_tests.procedure: Reproduce Billard et al. (2017) Table 1 Ge rates under their assumptions, then rescale to 3 GWth at 25 m and compare
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Billard Table 1 reproduced within about 20 percent and rescaled rate consistent within a factor of 2

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-muon
acceptance_tests.procedure: Integrate the muon event rate through the wafer and compare with the PDG sea-level flux times the wafer geometric acceptance

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-compton
acceptance_tests.procedure: Check that Compton edges appear at the Klein-Nishina energies E_edge = 2 E_gamma^2 / (m_e c^2 + 2 E_gamma) for the assumed gamma lines and that the total interaction rate matches the assumed flux times the Ge Compton cross section over the wafer
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Compton edges at predicted energies and interaction rate within a factor of about 2 of the flux-times-cross-section estimate

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-response
acceptance_tests.procedure: Check the low-energy limit (reconstructed energy equals 0.5 times deposited energy within statistical scatter) and the high-energy limit (response saturates once the tunneling rate exceeds 25 kHz)
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Both limiting behaviors reproduced by the pipeline

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-background
acceptance_tests.procedure: Reproduce both published CaWO4/Al2O3 neutron rate ratios from a single normalization: 1.81 in 10-100 eV and 1.20 in 0.1-1 keV
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Both ratios reproduced from one normalization before any Ge neutron number is trusted

acceptance_tests.subject: claim-sb
acceptance_tests.procedure: Rescale the pipeline to the CONUS+ configuration (3.6 GWth, 20.7 m, 7.4 m.w.e.) and reproduce its measured signal-to-background
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: CONUS+ S/B ~0.03 reproduced within a factor ~2; no headline S/B claimed until this passes

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-cevns
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Reporting spectra in deposited energy only without the reconstruction and bandwidth model
forbidden_proxies.reason: The decisive output is the spectrum in reconstructed energy

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-muon
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Muon spectrum computed without the 50 kHz bandwidth saturation model or without chord-length geometry
forbidden_proxies.reason: Saturation and thin-wafer geometry shape the muon response and omitting them would look like progress while skipping the decisive physics

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-compton
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Treating gamma deposits as full-energy photopeaks instead of the Compton continuum expected in a thin 2 mm wafer
forbidden_proxies.reason: In a thin wafer gammas predominantly single-Compton-scatter and escape, so the continuum, not photopeaks, is the physical signal

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-cevns
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Anchoring on the NUCLEUS Sect. 2 prose CEvNS value (280 counts/kg/day/keV) instead of their Table 5 entry at 100% duty (356.5)
forbidden_proxies.reason: The prose value is the 80%-duty number and their prose is internally inconsistent (the Al2O3 prose value matches its table entry at 100% duty). Anchoring on it flatters our Ge S/B by ~27%.

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-cevns
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Folding at the NUCLEUS 2019 prose site flux of 3e12 nubar/cm2/s
forbidden_proxies.reason: Their own Fig. 1 follows the geometric 1.83e12 sum and the 2026 paper states 2.1e12; folding at 3e12 overshoots their own figure by ~50%.

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-background
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Inheriting NUCLEUS gram-scale veto rejection factors (COV factor ~5, MV+COV > 99.8%, 3x3 multiplicity) for a 110 g monolithic wafer
forbidden_proxies.reason: Those factors are payload-coupled and geometry-specific. The wafer has ~11x the footprint and no multiplicity handle at all.

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-background
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Scaling the NUCLEUS CaWO4/Al2O3 residual backgrounds to germanium by a mass or cross-section argument
forbidden_proxies.reason: Discards the target dependence the paper itself emphasizes; the recoil spectrum shape differs because T_max/E_n is 0.0536 for Ge vs 0.0215 for W.

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-sb
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Reporting a signal-to-background number without the LEE overlay band
forbidden_proxies.reason: The LEE is absent from the NUCLEUS particle budget by their own statement, is design-dependent for a QPD, and is plausibly dominant below ~100 eV on a phonon-only device.

forbidden_proxies.subject: claim-response
forbidden_proxies.proxy: Quoting the emergent Poisson counting floor as the detector energy resolution
forbidden_proxies.reason: The project has no resolution model. The counting floor (15.9%/14.2% at 0.5 eV) omits baseline, amplifier, collection, position and readout noise, and the comparable unmodelled IA broadening (15.5-20.5% at 0.5 eV).

weakest_anchors: The lumped ~50% deposited-to-signal efficiency replaces the paper's design-dependent efficiency chain
Ta->Al device tunneling parameters are extrapolated rather than tabulated in the QPD paper
The absolute environmental gamma flux normalization for the Compton channel is a representative assumption, not a site measurement
unvalidated_assumptions: Uniform phonon-energy sharing among the ~10300 QPD sensors on the single instrumented face
qpd-repo EMG template parameters apply to a Ge wafer
Thin-wafer single-Compton-scatter dominance for the gamma background
disconfirming_observations: Computed total CEvNS rate disagrees with published Ge reactor predictions by more than an order of magnitude
The response chain shows no saturation even when tunneling rates far exceed the 25 kHz Nyquist limit
Compton edges appear at energies inconsistent with the Klein-Nishina prediction

open_questions: What crystal area is instrumented (one face vs all faces), fixing N_sens from the 1/mm^2 sensor density?
[RESOLVED Phase 5] Saturated-regime reconstruction: non-paralyzable dead-time model (count-integral estimator; plateau = saturation). User decision 2026-07-21.
[RESOLVED Phase 5] Ta->Al tunneling params: Table II Al-trap column; Ta absorber gap is a binary trapping gate (α-Ta ratio 3.58≥2), response numerically independent of it above the gate.

What absolute environmental gamma flux and line composition best represent a surface-level reactor-site deployment? [Phase 4: sourced from Heusser 1995 with a factor-2 site-dependent band; edges exact, total rate MEDIUM.]

decisions.summary: Design->parameter mapping locked in code: Ta->Al uses Table II Aluminum column, Al->Hf uses Hafnium column; absorber supplies only Delta_abs.
Hf tau_qp = 400 us adopted (caption/lit) over the 1 ms table cell, flagged MEDIUM.
Ta absorber gap encoded as bulk alpha-Ta BCS assumption 0.68 meV (MEDIUM), film phase flagged for Phase 5.
Saturation ordering fixed as the plateau Gamma_in Hf/Al ratio (3.17x); the 4.75x N_qp-per-eV ratio is the raw yield, not the saturation driver.
Per-design saturation onset energies (~1.27 eV Al / ~0.77 eV Hf) carry the two-exponential peak factor p (0.25 Al / 0.13 Hf); Hf saturates first.
E_rec estimator implemented as an explicit Phase-5 stub (NotImplementedError by default; linear_placeholder=True returns 0.5*E_dep, valid only in the unsaturated regime).
Both censoring variants exposed as a switch at tau_d=40us; the paralyzable-vs-non-paralyzable choice is preserved OPEN as a Phase-5 blocker, not silently chosen.
Huber(235/239/241)+Mueller(238U) coefficients fetched from primary arXiv e-prints with provenance; reconstructed 235U within 0.73%/0.13% of published Huber at 3/5 MeV.
238U(n,gamma) shape from sourced AME2020 Q-values, normalized to 0.6/fission (Kopeikin 2004).

Sub-1.8 MeV fission summation is a flagged seam-anchored non-negative placeholder pending Kopeikin-2012 grounding in 02-02; NOT invented, NOT truncated. Covered by the below-2-MeV uncertainty band (pre-anticipated ROADMAP risk).

Normalization chain R_f=P_th/<E_f>=9.10e19 fissions/s (3 GW_th, effective-thermal <E_f>=205.8 MeV Ma-2013 NOT total Q) x 1/(4 pi d^2) at d=2500 cm applied ONCE; int Phi dE=7.50e12 nu-bar/cm2/s, emission 1.96e20/s/GW_th (Hayes-Vogel ~2e20).

Frozen data/flux/reactor_flux_v1.0.csv with 7-col additive schema, SPLIT band (2-5% >2 MeV -> 20-25% <1.8 MeV, non-uniform), region flags, and version/git-sha/normalization/provenance/integral-check header.

Billard-2017 closure variant (HM constant below 2 MeV, fractions 55.6/32.6/7.1/4.7 isotope-labelled, no 238U<->239Pu swap) emitted as a distinct table (4.59e12) for the Phase-3 Billard Table-1 reproduction.

Sub-1.8 MeV shape kept as a Kopeikin-2012-cited placeholder (no machine-readable Kopeikin table sourceable; none fabricated), covered by the wide low-E band; limitation documented in CSV header, SUMMARY, and ASSUMPTIONS.md.

Per-isotope exact kinematics: E_min^(i)(T)=(T+sqrt(T^2+2 M_i T))/2, T_max^(i)=2E_nu^2/(M_i+2E_nu); PCHIP log-flux interp + adaptive quad fold. sigma(72Ge,4MeV)=1.0026e-40 (0.26% from anchor); closed-form identity to <=6e-8.
dR/dT = 67.8 counts/kg/day above 50 eV_nr at OUR 3 GW_th/25 m config
decisions.rationale: genuine physics (~90x Billard's 0.76 at 8.54 GW/400 m, matching the geometry/power ratio). >20% backtrack trigger NOT met; absolute Billard/CONUS+ comparison deferred to 03-02 via the k~=0.0111 rescale.

decisions.summary: Helm F^2 (Lewin-Smith): 0.9963 at 200 eV, 0.9639 at 2 keV endpoint; turning F off shifts integrated rate 0.38%. CONVENTIONS 'F^2>0.998' = dominant sub-200 eV regime; 0.964 = rare E_nu~8-10 MeV tail. Reconciled to avoid downstream misflag.
Ge isotope abundances = IUPAC/CIAAW representative number fractions (MEDIUM); M_i=A*931.494 MeV; 73Ge axial term ~1/N^2 not modeled (stated assumption).

Derived Billard renormalization k=(P_B/P_v)(d_v/d_B)^2: single-source (8.54 GW/400 m) 0.011120 vs two-core (4.27 GW at 355.39 & 468.76 m) 0.011092, agree 0.25%; k-rescaled Billard integral flux 5.10e10 nu cm^-2 s^-1. Both powers thermal (GW_th), distance squared (fp-gwe-gwth rejected).

Billard 2017 Table 1 reproduced WITH k: 0.7415/0.5009/0.2567 counts/kg/day above 50/100/200 eV_nr vs 0.76/0.51/0.26 (-2.4/-1.8/-1.3%, all <2.5%, well inside ~20%). WITHOUT k the fold overshoots by exactly 1/k=89.9x (66.7/45.0/23.1). 100/200 eV bins <2% so no ROADMAP backtrack. Per-isotope Ge sum (fp-lumped-A-billard rejected).

CONUS+ coarse factor-2 cross-check: flagship (67.75/kg/day >50 eV) and Billard Table 1 both rescaled to CONUS+ config (3.6 GW_th/20.7 m) give 118.6 vs 119.6, ratio 0.99. Two independently-normalized flux models agree at a common config. eV_ee quenching caveat -> coarse scale check only, MEDIUM confidence.

Flux band propagation: rigorous 1-sigma band 3.4% (>=95 eV, matches well-anchored 2-5% high-E flux) rising to 6.2%/9.8% at 50/20 eV_nr; sub-1.8 MeV toggle localizes the placeholder systematic below ~95 eV (E_min(95 eV)~1.78 MeV): sub-1.8 rate fraction 17.8% at 50 eV, 33.8% at 20 eV, ~0 above 95 eV, T>200 eV unchanged <1e-3. The plan's 20-25% guess is corrected (finding, not a bug).

Muon dR/dE_dep folded from Gaisser-Guan flux (P1-P5 verbatim, arXiv:1509.06176) x analytic ray-box chord (Cauchy <ell>=0.385 cm reproduced to 0.03%) x Landau-Vavilov MPV. Integral rate 1.366 +/- 0.005 Hz (deterministic quadrature 1.415 Hz), within ~15% of PDG 1.5-2 Hz (VALD-02). Surface-flux measure I*A_proj*sin(theta) validated by J_horiz=pi*I_v/2 to 0.01%.

Landau-Vavilov MPV computed in code (not memorized): vertical-chord xi=0.0721 MeV (PDG 0.072), Delta_p=1.232 MeV strictly below mean 1.459 MeV. Custom Landau inverse-CDF sampler (mode -0.22278); deposit=Delta_p+xi*(lambda-lambda_mode) so sampled mode=Delta_p; NOT mean, NOT Moyal. kappa=xi/T_max<0.07 for all chords -> Landau/mild-Vavilov. Guards fp-mean-not-mpv.

Long near-horizontal chords importance-sampled (zenith uniform in [0,pi/2] with reweighting) so the deposit tail is resolved to ~197 MeV (66 bins >30 MeV) - the Phase-5 saturation input. Deposits on the unified phonon E_dep scale, NO quenching, no keVee/keVnr (electron recoil, zero Frenkel correction). Guards fp-angular-bias, fp-quenching-muon.

Compton dR/dE_dep built as a Klein-Nishina angle-sampled ELECTRON-recoil continuum (deposit T_e=E_gamma-E_prime, scattered photon escapes the optically-thin 2mm wafer; NO photopeaks) up to each self-validating edge E_edge=2E^2/(m_ec^2+2E). VALD-03 edges reproduced: 40K->1243.4, 208Tl->2381.8, 214Bi->1541.3 keV (max sampled T_e = E_edge per line, exact). No signal above the max edge or at E_gamma=2614.5. Guards fp-full-absorption, fp-electron-not-photon.

Total single-scatter Compton rate 0.268 Hz vs independent flux x sigma_KN x N_e anchor 0.273 Hz (ratio 0.983, within VALD-03 factor 2). Thin-target on the ONE pinned Cauchy mean chord ell_bar=4V/S=0.385 cm: mu*ell_bar=0.117@1MeV / 0.084@2MeV, double-scatter 1.4%; normal-incidence mu*t=0.061 quoted as optically-thin demo only. Same ell_bar in P, double-scatter, and rate. Energy closure to ~1e-5.

ORCHESTRATOR CORRECTION: the scout flagged the 'tens-to-hundreds of millions of CPU-hours' figure as unverifiable; it IS in the paper, p.21: 'throughout this work required tens, even hundreds, millions of hours of computing time', plus the statement that variance-reduction techniques will be required. The scout's grep missed it across a line break. Full Geant4 transport stays OUT OF SCOPE. The scout's independent point stands: a 1-D spherical-shell shield-only MC is a far cheaper fallback than NUCLEUS's full building+4pi+sub-keV chain.

decisions.summary: RESOLVED (orchestrator, pre-roadmap): anchor on NUCLEUS Table 5 at 100% duty, NOT the Sect.2 prose; Ge/CaWO4 signal ratio 2.31 same-pipeline
decisions.rationale: Pitfalls scout flagged a blocking 1.27x ambiguity between Table 5 CaWO4 CEvNS (218.2 mcpd -> 356.5 d^-1kg^-1keV^-1 at their stated 6.8 g / 90 eV RoI) and Sect.2 prose (about 280). Rendered-PDF read confirms the CEvNS row has exactly ONE value per column (218.2/60.7/8.4/-), killing the 'two sub-columns lost in text extraction' hypothesis. Arbitrated with our own pipeline: an independent CaWO4 fold (Ca+W+O natural isotopes, VNS flux 2.1e12, Helm FF, per-isotope) gives 407.7 -> 1.14x the table value and 1.46x the prose value. Table 5 at 100% duty is therefore the correct anchor; prose 280 is the 80%-duty value (356.5*0.8=285). Their prose is internally inconsistent: the Al2O3 prose 20 matches its table entry at 100% (20.7), not 80%. Anchoring on prose would flatter our Ge S/B by 27%. SIGNAL-SIDE CLOSURE TEST PASSED at 14%. CORRECTION to an earlier orchestrator claim: compound N^2/A for CaWO4 is 44.2 (not 65.8 = pure W); naive ratio 1.95 vs folded 2.31, so the naive scaling must not be used as the benchmark. Ge 176.8 vs CaWO4 407.7 d^-1kg^-1keV^-1, both same-pipeline.

decisions.summary: Sub-100 keV flux truncation DOWNGRADED from gating to a <=0.81% bounded systematic; quantum broadening promoted to the largest new physics input
decisions.rationale: Computed the bound directly: flat continuation of Phi at its 100 keV value, with the (1-MT/2E^2) kinematic factor, gives missing/total <= 0.81% at T=100 meV and exactly 0 above 0.29 eV. True error far smaller (allowed beta branches give dN/dE ~ E^2 as E->0). Action: report the bound, do NOT extend the flux table. Also v1.0 was already extrapolating (Huber-Mueller fitted only 2-8 MeV). E_min reconciled: 58.16 keV at natural-Ge mean mass 72.63 u vs 58.7 keV for 74Ge alone. REPLACING it as the sub-eV blocker: impulse-approximation quantum broadening, sigma_E = sqrt(E_R*omega_bar), fractional width 35-46% at 100 meV, 11-15% at 1 eV, negligible >100 eV -- absent from v1.0 and gated on first fixing omega_bar (12-21 meV from <u^2> vs 37 meV optical differ 2-3x). Unified phonon scale STRENGTHENED in-window by the SuperCDMS Ge displacement threshold 19.7 eV with no defect below ~6 eV (APL 113, 092101); no crystal-wide coherence (q*a~144). LEE is design-dependent for a QPD (Romani JAP 136,124502: Al-film dislocation relaxation scaling with film area; ~10300 films here). CONUS+ S/B~0.03 is the only measured Ge-at-reactor value -- must be reproduced as a limiting case before claiming 0.65-1.2.

decisions.summary: USER DECISION 2026-07-22: sub-eV observable is a TRIGGER-PROBABILITY curve; sigmoid analysis efficiency with 50% point at 0.5 eV, multiplied on top of all other efficiencies
decisions.rationale: Below ~1 eV deposit, dR/dE_rec presupposes the lumped 50% collection efficiency, which is not defensible for a ~3-optical-phonon-quantum deposit in Ge. User chose to report a trigger-probability curve instead. Threshold: sigmoid with the 50% point at 0.5 eV. This ANALYSIS efficiency multiplies on top of everything else, including the existing eps~=0.5 deposited-to-signal collection efficiency -- it does NOT replace it. FINDING (orchestrator, from the code): the project has NO resolution parameter anywhere and did NOT quote the QPD paper for resolution. The width of R(E_rec|E_dep) is emergent counting statistics only -- multinomial over the per-sensor EMG pmf (unsaturated) or Poisson (saturated) on the registered tunneling count. total_N_obs = 39.4 (Ta->Al) / 49.9 (Al->Hf) at 0.5 eV, so the Poisson floor is 15.9%/14.2% there; 35.6%/31.6% at 0.1 eV; 3.6%/3.2% at 10 eV; 1.2%/1.1% at 100 eV. This is a BEST-CASE resolution: no baseline/amplifier noise, no phonon-collection fluctuation, no position dependence, no readout noise. At the 0.5 eV threshold the impulse-approximation quantum broadening (15.5-20.5% for omega_bar 12-21 meV) is COMPARABLE to the counting floor and is not yet in the model; the two add in quadrature to ~22-26%.
